title: voidkeep
description: a customizable Mod/Plugin that saves players inventories and xp on void death (ADDED SUPPORT FOR FORGE)
body:
# A Mod/Plugin to keep inventory and XP when falling into the void.

## What it adds
VoidKeep lets you toggle keep inventory for void deaths specifically, you can toggle just inventory keep or xp keep as well

## Void keep Installation
just drag into your Mod/Plugin folder and start the client/server no external dependencies required

## Configuration changes
you can use /voidkeep reload to reload the config file you can also use /voidkeep toggle to toggle functions

## Supports Forge, Paper and working on Fabric/NeoForge
On forge mc versions 1.20.1–1.20.6 are curently supported
Paper only 1.21.4 is curently tested
